I just played Laser Tag with some colleagues for the first time and just wanted to say Barney Stinson was right, as always. Laser Tag is super awesome.
Why is it so fun? Seriously. I'm hard pressed to think of anything else that is that fun for any age.

Because if you have adults in at least average shape it is a fast paced game with a few strategic elements. It's not like paint ball where it's one hit and you're out. It doesn't matter how many times you get hit, but each time your own gun deactivates for five seconds. So you have to move all the time between covers, because if you get hit constantly, you can't score yourself.

You get points for hitting other players or strategic elements (which the others have to defend), depending on the game mode. It can be all vs. all or team based. Our last round was supercharged, where the gun deactivates only two seconds after a hit. That makes it even faster, because you only have two seconds to hide until the opponent can shoot back.

My first time playing, I was crawling up a small bank to flank the other team. The second I popped my head over the hill I was shot in the face. My cheek swelled a little but if I weren't wearing goggles it would've fucked my eye up.

That's it. No chance for redemption. Just raised the gun and walked off the field with my head hanging low.
Laser Tag is a good game to play. Do you know what is even more fun to play? Taser Tag.
